# Siddhi Sarees Order Analytics Dashboard

> An order analytics dashboard built during a summer internship at Siddhi Sarees (June to July 2026). It shows sales, order status, the eight-stage production workflow and team workload. All data is synthetic: 1,060 generated orders from January to June 2026.

The dashboard is one page of semantic HTML, hand-written CSS and plain JavaScript, with Chart.js for the charts. There is no framework and no build step.

## Page

- [Dashboard](./): KPIs with month-on-month changes, a live pipeline of where active orders are waiting, seven charts that filter the page when clicked, a sortable team table, and an order register with search and CSV export. Each order opens a timeline of its eight stages; each employee opens their workload.
